title: ZCode Plugin Manifest
description: Plugin manifest accepted by ZCode (Z.ai) at .zcode-plugin/plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, or .codex-plugin/plugin.json. Authored from the official authoring page and the shipped runtime; ZCode publishes no JSON Schema. Unknown properties are ignored by the client, so this schema is open.
$comment: Provenance: authored (not upstream-vendored) 2026-09-08. Sources: https://zcode.z.ai/en/docs/plugin ; https://github.com/zai-org/zcode-plugins (docs/distribution.md, docs/PLUGIN_DEVELOPMENT.md, scripts/validate.py, plugins/example-plugin) ; ZCode 3.11.2 runtime constants (manifest candidate order). Fields channels/lspServers/outputStyles/settings are registered but diagnostic-only in the observed runtime.

version.description: Semantic version. The runtime defaults to "0.0.0" when absent. The official marketplace validator requires this to equal the marketplace entry version.

description.description: One-line description shown in the plugin manager.

description_i18n.description: Localized descriptions keyed by BCP-47 locale. Required for community submissions by the official marketplace validator (en and zh-CN), which also requires it to match the marketplace entry.

author.description: Author as a bare name or a structured record.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers: a path to a JSON file, an array of such paths, or an inline server map. Inline entries override same-named servers from .mcp.json.

dependencies.description: Other plugins required at enable time. A bare name resolves inside the declaring marketplace; use name@marketplace for another marketplace.

userConfig.description: User-configurable options prompted when the plugin is enabled. Values are referenced as ${user_config.<key>} in MCP declarations and hooks.

channels.description: Registered but diagnostic-only in the observed ZCode runtime; not executed.

lspServers.description: Registered but diagnostic-only in the observed ZCode runtime; not executed.

outputStyles.description: Registered but diagnostic-only in the observed ZCode runtime; not executed.

settings.description: Registered but diagnostic-only in the observed ZCode runtime; not executed.

component.description: Component declaration: a relative path, an array of relative paths, or an inline object. ZCode resolves relative paths against the plugin root.

sensitive.description: Masked in the UI and not enterable interactively.
